description.fun: Mienfoo is a kung fu ermine. It overwhelms foes with flowing, non-stop combos, making up in quantity for what it lacks in power, and a well-trained one can chop more than 100 times a minute. Packs train secluded in the mountains, each with its own style of kicks and chops, and in the mornings they move slowly through a series of poses. It was created when planners asked for Fighting Pokémon based on animals.
description.guide: Mienfoo is a Fighting-type weasel Pokémon based on an ermine and a kung fu fighter. It attacks with fast, flowing combinations. It evolves into Mienshao.
description.tagline: A kung fu weasel whose chops come too fast to count.

description.fun: Mienshao wields the long fur on its arms like whips, launching combos of kicks and chops so fast they can't be seen. A bizarre wail means you're in danger. When it meets a truly challenging opponent, it bites off its arm fur to make itself lighter. Its flowing sleeves may recall the 'water sleeves' of Chinese opera, and its name blends 'ermine' with 'Shaolin'. Megumi Mizutani designed it.
description.guide: Mienshao is the evolved form of Mienfoo, a Fighting-type Pokémon that uses its long arm fur like whips. Its combinations of kicks and chops are too fast to see.
description.tagline: A whip-sleeved kung fu master that wails before it strikes.
